content: आर्यकः [आर्य-स्वार्थे-कन्] .²1 An honourable or respectable man. .²2 A grandfather; बलेन गुप्तो भरतो महात्मा सहार्यकस्यात्मसमैरमात्यैः <ls>Rām. 2. 70. 30</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a cowherd who became a king; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Mk. 7</ls>. .{@-कम्@} A ceremony performed to the Manes or the vessel used in sacrifices to the Manes.
